messages:
sam.k: noticed a spike of 403s from the code-scan artifact uploader right after the RBAC keystore policy push. failing PRs: ci/scan-564, ci/scan-565.

lina: can you paste the uploader error? is it GetKey or PutObject?

sam.k: log snippet: ```ERROR: evidence-uploader: requestId=ff12a3 PutObject -> 403 
{"message":"denied","principal":"svc-ci-scanner","action":"keystore:GetKey","key":"secret/scan/evidence"}```

infra-bot: alert: 403 spikes detected for service svc-ci-scanner across eu-west-1 during window 2026-03-21T02:10Z..02:15Z. Linked incident INC-7082. :exclamation:

derek: we rotated keystore bindings at 02:00 to replace legacy-group with new-group-based policy. looks like the role-binding for service accounts using `svc-ci-scanner` alias was omitted.

lina: temporary mitigation idea: flip uploader to use service account svc-uploader-proxy which has a separate keystore grant and is already allowed. we can toggle CI via env var USE_UPLOADER_PROXY=1. need oncall approval.

oncall-rotation: approve a 90-minute exception to switch to proxy for ingestion. record in audit with justification.

sam.k: pushing a quick pipeline patch: ```env: USE_UPLOADER_PROXY=1 
step: run uploader --target proxy``` will deploy to the main CI job now. attaching the CI run.

derek: i'll patch the RBAC binding to include the svc-ci-scanner alias and run `keystorectl whohas --key secret/scan/evidence` to verify mapping. also adding an integration smoke test to the rotation playbook.

lina: long-term: we need 1) rotation PR template that lists all service-account aliases, 2) an automated post-rotation smoke that runs a tiny put/get with the uploader service, and 3) keystore audit logs to include full principal arn + binding id.

infra-bot: automation note: created ticket SEC-9127 for runbook updates and gating.

sam.k: deployed proxy flag. first upload attempt after change: HTTP 200, evidence id e-20260321-1423 stored. DAST run finished.

derek: RBAC fix pushed to staging: roleBinding dev-keystore-access now includes `subjects: - kind: ServiceAccount name: svc-ci-scanner namespace: ci`. running verification: `keystorectl whohas secret/scan/evidence` -> returns svc-ci-scanner, svc-uploader-proxy.

lina: please ensure the keystore audit log for the failed event is preserved for compliance review. we need the original 403 with requestId ff12a3 in the evidence bundle.

oncall-rotation: confirmed audit trail retention enabled for INC-7082. added approver and timebox notes.

sam.k: attaching grep from uploader logs: `grep ff12a3 /var/log/uploader/* | sed -n '1,120p'` and uploaded to SEC-9127.

(later) sam.k: proxy toggled off, original role binding validated in prod, and a postmortem task created to add a CI gate: `post-keystore-rotation: run uploader --smoke` that must pass before merge.

derek: will add `audit: true` to keystore policy so GetKey calls include actor email and binding id in logs. also adding a synthetic monitor to detect 403 rate > 5/min.

lina: thanks all. follow-up owners: sam.k (incident notes + log upload), derek (RBAC fix + keystore audit config), me (runbook PR + gating GH action). ETA for runbook and gating: 48h.

infra-bot: incident INC-7082 -> resolved. closing the urgent thread. :white_check_mark:

sam.k: retro note: consider a pre-rotation checklist step to run `ci:smoke-upload` across namespaces to avoid missed aliases.
